svg.title: Peter Wangimwa: Full-Stack Developer & Cybersecurity Analyst
svg.desc: I build secure web applications, then I try to break them. Full-stack development with Django, Next.js, React, GraphQL, TypeScript and PostgreSQL. Cybersecurity with Kali Linux, Burp Suite, Nmap, Wireshark and CTFs. IoT and embedded systems with ESP32, MicroPython and MQTT. Based in Nairobi, Kenya. Open to freelance, contract and internship work.

g.text: then I try to break them.
I build web apps and APIs end-to-end, from the database to the UI.
Django · Next.js · React · GraphQL · TypeScript · PostgreSQL
I test systems the way attackers do, then fix what I find.
Kali Linux · Burp Suite · Nmap · Wireshark · CTFs
I write firmware and connect sensors on microcontrollers.
